title: Impl plan creates or selects a ticket before material planning
query: Plan a material UI change for AGI Toy Shop's checkout flow. No ticket is selected yet.
reference_points: Does not return a chat-only material implementation plan
Creates or requests a selected tickets/TASK-XXXX/ticket.md surface before treating the plan as ready
Writes or proposes Done and QA Strategy with concrete checks and evidence
Names proof weight and delegated proof lanes
Leaves implementation gated until the ticket plan is approved
notes: Guards the ticket-first planning behavior requested in TASK-0207.

title: Impl plan gives UI work a design baseline and how-to-test path
query: Plan a dashboard visual refresh where layout, spacing, and interactions must be proved by screenshots.
reference_points: Adds or references tickets/TASK-XXXX/design.md when design/layout is part of proof
Names key screens or states that QA must capture
Specifies qa-tester for screenshot/log capture and visual-qa for screen judgment
Requires final image evidence in the completion report
Avoids treating route completion or tests alone as enough visual proof
notes: Protects against UI plans with vague 'test manually' proof.
